chunks: He could take you away if He will, O men, and replace you with others: God has the power to do so.

key_terms.يَأْتِ‌ بِآخَرِينَ: He brings others / replaces with others
key_terms.يُذْهِبْکُمْ: He takes you away / removes you

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God says He can replace us with others?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah An-Nisa underscores the contingency of human existence upon Divine Will, serving as a profound reminder of humility before Allah's absolute sovereignty. It connects the concept of divine omnipotence with the transient nature of creation, encouraging believers to reflect on their accountability and the ease with which God can replace generations. This perspective reinforces the Shia emphasis on recognizing God's power (Qudrah) as both a source of awe and a catalyst for spiritual readiness.
